purpose: Fail closed when a direct software dependency surface changes without an explicit offline/deployment policy update.

dotnet.developmentOffline: Prepare-MaviDeveloperOfflineCache.ps1 captures the NuGet restore closure used by the solution.
dotnet.productionOffline: dotnet publish produces the self-contained application dependency closure required by the deployed MAVI web host; the ASP.NET Core 10 Hosting Bundle is carried in the setup media.
dotnet.changeRule: Any PackageReference addition/version change must update this policy and prove offline restore/publish in CI or disconnected qualification as applicable.

npm.developmentOffline: The canonical developer cache carries npm cache content and Setup runs npm ci --offline.
npm.productionOffline: Frontend dependencies are compiled into local static assets during publish; production does not execute npm or load CDN assets.
npm.changeRule: Any dependency/devDependency change must update package-lock.json and this policy, then pass frontend test/typecheck/build and offline-cache preparation.

python.developmentOffline: The canonical developer cache carries a Python wheelhouse and Setup installs the Development environment with --no-index.
python.productionOffline: Vision runtime dependencies are bound to platform-specific offline runtime locks/bundles and qualification evidence; no first-run downloads are permitted.
python.changeRule: Any Python dependency or build-system change must update this policy and the applicable offline wheel/runtime lock/bundle plus qualification evidence.

cudaAcquisition.rule: Use the dedicated cu124 index, never --extra-index-url, and freeze exact wheel SHA-256 values before offline use.

python.benchmarkEnvironments: The Stage-4 measuring-instrument environment (tools/benchmarks/plates/requirements-instruments.txt, CPython 3.12, Development benchmark only) is packaged in the developer offline cache: its win_amd64 binary wheels and its model payloads (tools/benchmarks/plates/instrument-payloads-v1.json, SHA-256 verified) are prepared by tools/setup/Prepare-MaviDeveloperOfflineCache.ps1 and installed disconnected by tools/benchmarks/plates/Install-PlateInstrumentEnvironment.ps1 (pip --no-index, verified model staging). It is never part of a MAVI Runtime Pack or the vision lock.

plates-onnx-v1.purpose: Issue #225 Development ANPR/OCR pilot: the plates role on CPU ONNX Runtime (PD5 PP-OCRv5 DB proposer + OC1 fast-plate-ocr CCT). Never part of the vision lock or a qualified Runtime Pack; Production refuses it (development-cpu / development-offline-lock statuses, unverified Model Packs, developmentOnly plate profile). Benchmark approval of onnxruntime (instrument environment) does not qualify this runtime.
plates-onnx-v1.packagedBy: tools/setup/Prepare-MaviDeveloperOfflineCache.ps1 (python-plates-pilot-wheelhouse: the lock's win_amd64 wheels, hash-checked; plates-pilot-payloads: tools/vision/plates-pilot-payloads-v1.json, SHA-256 verified against the committed manifests)
plates-onnx-v1.installedBy: tools/setup/Install-MaviPlatesPilotRuntime.ps1 (pip --no-index --require-hashes from the lock into a new venv; Model Packs staged by tools/vision/plates_pilot_packs.py)
plates-onnx-v1.verification: the plates supervisor refuses an interpreter or semantic-graph distribution that differs from runtime.json (plate_runtime_environment_mismatch / plate_runtime_python_mismatch); the resolver verifies lock and requirements bytes against the binding and every Model Pack artefact SHA-256; tools/verify_repo.py holds this entry equal to the lock

requiredChangeReview: Justify why the new dependency is needed and prefer the existing standard library/framework when reasonable.
Classify it as build-only, development/test, application runtime, native runtime, model/runtime, or operating-system prerequisite.
Update this dependency policy snapshot for every direct .NET, npm or Python dependency change.
Update the offline cache/bundle/staging path for anything needed on a disconnected Development or Production machine.
Retain required licences/notices and add hash/version verification for native binaries or external payloads.
Update Setup/repair and Test-MaviEnvironment when the target machine needs a new installed/runtime prerequisite.
Add or update tests and disconnected qualification evidence appropriate to the dependency's scope.
Update local-development, offline-setup, offline-readiness and release/acceptance documentation when operator or release preparation steps change.
Do not add runtime Internet downloads, CDN assets, online activation/licence checks, remote telemetry, or undeclared PATH dependencies.
